:::{#exm-deriv-lincom-tp}
#### Derivative of a transpose product

Let $\vx = \tp{(3, 5)}$ and $\vb = \tp{(\beta_1, \beta_2)}$.
Then $\tp{\vx}\vb = 3\beta_1 + 5\beta_2$, and by @cor-deriv-lincom-tp:

$$
\underbrace{\deriv{\vb}\left(\underbrace{\tp{\vx}}_{1 \times 2}\underbrace{\vb}_{2 \times 1}\right)}_{2 \times 1}
= \underbrace{\vx}_{2 \times 1}
= \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\
5 \end{pmatrix}
$$

:::
